dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんっ！！」
dialogues.en: "Niisan!!"
dialogues.text: "Niisan!!"

dialogues.jp:
暗闇の｛かなた／彼方｝から、音夢の声がぼんやりと聞こ
える。
dialogues.en: I vaguely heard Nemu's voice inside the darkness.
dialogues.text: I vaguely heard Nemu's voice inside the darkness.

dialogues.jp:
意識は揺らぐが、身体が無茶苦茶だるくて起き
る気がしない……。
dialogues.en:
My mind was trying to be conscious, but I don't feel like
waking up because my body's exhausted......
dialogues.text:
My mind was trying to be conscious, but I don't feel like
waking up because my body's exhausted......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんッ」
dialogues.en: "Niisan!!"
dialogues.text: "Niisan!!"

dialogues.jp:
なおも続く音夢の呼び声。普段と違うその必死
の叫び声が気になって……。
dialogues.en:
Her voice continued to echo. Her unusual tone of voice made
me alert......
dialogues.text:
Her voice continued to echo. Her unusual tone of voice made
me alert......

dialogues.jp: 仕方なく目を開ける。
dialogues.en: I had no choice but to open my eyes.
dialogues.text: I had no choice but to open my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん！」
dialogues.en: "Niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Niisan!"

dialogues.jp:
｛まぶた／瞼｝を開けると、目の前に驚いた顔の音夢が飛び
込んできた。
dialogues.en:
When I opened my eyes, I saw Nemu's frightened face in front
of me.
dialogues.text:
When I opened my eyes, I saw Nemu's frightened face in front
of me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「よかったぁ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad......"
dialogues.text: "I'm glad......"

dialogues.jp:
音夢が心底安心した……気の抜けたような声を
漏らす。
dialogues.en: She spoke with a relieved but distressed voice.
dialogues.text: She spoke with a relieved but distressed voice.

dialogues.jp: 「……どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "......What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "......What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: わけの分からない態度に疑問を口にする。
dialogues.en: I asked her as she acted strangely.
dialogues.text: I asked her as she acted strangely.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだ、じゃないわよ。もう……心配
　したんだから」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean, what's wrong? You really scared me......"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean, what's wrong? You really scared me......"

dialogues.jp:
ホントに泣き出しそうな……よく見ると目尻に
涙をためて、音夢が｛こら／堪｝えるように呟く。
dialogues.en: She spoke with her eyes full of tears, trying not to cry.
dialogues.text: She spoke with her eyes full of tears, trying not to cry.

dialogues.jp: 「いや……マジでどうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "I mean...... what happened?"
dialogues.text: "I mean...... what happened?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の普通じゃない様子に一気に目が覚め、俺
は上体を起こそうと――。
dialogues.en:
Her unusual behavior woke my mind up, and I tried to lift my
body up......
dialogues.text:
Her unusual behavior woke my mind up, and I tried to lift my
body up......

dialogues.jp:
身体に痛みが走り、１ｃｍぐらい浮いたところ
で再びベッドに沈み込む。
dialogues.en:
When I lifted up myself about 1cm, I felt a sharp pain in my
body and lay back on the bed.
dialogues.text:
When I lifted up myself about 1cm, I felt a sharp pain in my
body and lay back on the bed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あっ！」
dialogues.en: "Oh!"
dialogues.text: "Oh!"

dialogues.jp: 滅茶苦茶な痛みに、上手く息ができない。
dialogues.en: I can't breathe smoothly because of the tremendous pain.
dialogues.text: I can't breathe smoothly because of the tremendous pain.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう、動いたらだめじゃない！　傷口が開い
　たら、どうするのよっ」
dialogues.en: "You can't move! What if your wound opens up again?"
dialogues.text: "You can't move! What if your wound opens up again?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が慌てて俺の胸を押さえつける。
dialogues.en: She pressed on my chest in a hurry.
dialogues.text: She pressed on my chest in a hurry.

dialogues.jp: 「傷口？」
dialogues.en: "What wound?"
dialogues.text: "What wound?"

dialogues.jp:
押さえつけられた自分の身体を見て、不思議な
違和感を感じる。
dialogues.en:
I felt a weird feeling as I saw her pressing against my
body.
dialogues.text:
I felt a weird feeling as I saw her pressing against my
body.

dialogues.jp: 見慣れない布団が俺の身体にのっている。
dialogues.en: I see an unfamiliar blanket on my body.
dialogues.text: I see an unfamiliar blanket on my body.

dialogues.jp: 白いシーツに、白いベッド、白い天井……。
dialogues.en:
I also see a white sheet, white bed, and a white
ceiling......
dialogues.text:
I also see a white sheet, white bed, and a white
ceiling......

dialogues.jp: 「ここは……」
dialogues.en: "Am I in the......"
dialogues.text: "Am I in the......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「病院。昨日、救急車で運ばれて来たんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Hospital. You were brought here yesterday by the
ambulance."
dialogues.text:
"Hospital. You were brought here yesterday by the
ambulance."

dialogues.jp: そうか、俺は萌先輩を｛かば／庇｝って……。
dialogues.en: That's right. I tried to protect Moe-sempai......
dialogues.text: That's right. I tried to protect Moe-sempai......

dialogues.jp: 「そうだっ、萌先輩は無事なのか？」
dialogues.en: "That's right! Is Moe-sempai okay?"
dialogues.text: "That's right! Is Moe-sempai okay?"

dialogues.jp:
ちゃんと庇ったつもりだったが、実際のところ
どうだったんだろう？
dialogues.en:
I was trying to protect her, but I don't know what really
happened......
dialogues.text:
I was trying to protect her, but I don't know what really
happened......

dialogues.jp:
意識がなくなる前に聞こえた声は、平気そうだっ
たけど……。
dialogues.en:
I thought I heard her voice before I lost
consciousness......
dialogues.text:
I thought I heard her voice before I lost
consciousness......

dialogues.jp:
頭から血を流してアスファルトに横たわる萌先
輩の姿を想像してゾッとする。なんだかいても
立ってもいられない……。
dialogues.en:
I felt a chill as I imagined Moe-sempai lying on the
concrete with blood coming out from her head. The thought
really scared me......
dialogues.text:
I felt a chill as I imagined Moe-sempai lying on the
concrete with blood coming out from her head. The thought
really scared me......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫。少し｛あざ／痣｝とかはあったみたいだけど、
　大きな怪我とかはないみたい」
dialogues.en: "She's fine. She had some bruises, but no serious injuries."
dialogues.text: "She's fine. She had some bruises, but no serious injuries."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
それは良かった。フッと心の緊張が解ける。
dialogues.en: That's good to hear. I felt relieved inside.
dialogues.text: That's good to hear. I felt relieved inside.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「人の心配もいいですけど、自分の身体も気に
　かけてよ」
dialogues.en:
"It's not wrong to care about others, but you need to take
care of yourself too."
dialogues.text:
"It's not wrong to care about others, but you need to take
care of yourself too."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「俺ってどのくらいのケガなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "How bad did I get hurt?"
dialogues.text: "How bad did I get hurt?"

dialogues.jp:
見たところ、他に患者はいない――っていうか、
個室だな。
dialogues.en:
There are no other patients in the room. I guess I have a
private room.
dialogues.text:
There are no other patients in the room. I guess I have a
private room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「右足の骨がちょっと折れてるみたい。｛せんせい／医師｝の
　話だと全治１ヶ月だって」
dialogues.en:
"You have a small fracture in your right leg. It's going to
take about a month to heal."
dialogues.text:
"You have a small fracture in your right leg. It's going to
take about a month to heal."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん……」
｛・・・・／ちょっと｝骨折か……。
dialogues.en: Small fracture...... huh?
dialogues.text: Small fracture...... huh?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「『ふーん』じゃないでしょ。もし打ち所が
　悪かったら死んじゃってたかもしれないん
　だよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Don't be nonchalant! You could have died if you had hit the
wrong spot!"
dialogues.text:
"Don't be nonchalant! You could have died if you had hit the
wrong spot!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、それは――」
dialogues.en: "No, I don't think so......"
dialogues.text: "No, I don't think so......"

dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: Knock, knock......
dialogues.text: Knock, knock......

dialogues.jp: 俺の声を｛さえぎ／遮｝るように扉がノックされる。
dialogues.en: Someone knocked at the door as I spoke.
dialogues.text: Someone knocked at the door as I spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: ガチャ
dialogues.en: Click.
dialogues.text: Click.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「遅くなりました。あの……朝倉くんの様子は
　どうでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Sorry I'm late. Umm...... How's Asakura-kun doing?"
dialogues.text: "Sorry I'm late. Umm...... How's Asakura-kun doing?"

dialogues.jp:
中に入ってくるなり、萌先輩が音夢に向かって
尋ねる。その表情はとても不安げだった。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai asked Nemu as soon as she came into the room. She
had a worried expression on her face.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai asked Nemu as soon as she came into the room. She
had a worried expression on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「たった今、目を覚ましたところです」
dialogues.en: "He just woke up."
dialogues.text: "He just woke up."

dialogues.jp: 俺と目が合った瞬間、萌先輩が駆け寄って来る。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai came running to me as soon as she saw me.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai came running to me as soon as she saw me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん……良かったです……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun...... I'm so glad......"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun...... I'm so glad......"

dialogues.jp:
ベッドの脇にひざまずくと、俺の胸に顔を押し
つけてきた。
dialogues.en: She kneeled by the bed and pressed her face on my chest.
dialogues.text: She kneeled by the bed and pressed her face on my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.jp: 徐々に胸元が湿ってくるのを感じる。
dialogues.en: I could gradually feel my chest getting wet.
dialogues.text: I could gradually feel my chest getting wet.

dialogues.jp: 「ど、どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉くんの起きている顔を見たら、ほっとし
　てしまいました……」
dialogues.en: "I felt so relieved seeing you awake......"
dialogues.text: "I felt so relieved seeing you awake......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、もし朝倉くんがいなくなってしまった
　らと考えたら、とても苦しくなって……」
dialogues.en:
"I thought I'd lost you yesterday, and I felt
devastated...... I didn't know what to do......"
dialogues.text:
"I thought I'd lost you yesterday, and I felt
devastated...... I didn't know what to do......"

dialogues.jp: 顔を上げて萌先輩が俺のことを見つめる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai lifted her head up and stared at me.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai lifted her head up and stared at me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「本当に……良かったです」
dialogues.en: "I'm so glad......"
dialogues.text: "I'm so glad......"

dialogues.jp:
まるで、愛の告白のような萌先輩の視線に、こ
う――胸が高鳴ってくる。
dialogues.en:
My heart was starting to pound as I looked at her. It was as
if she was confessing her love toward me......
dialogues.text:
My heart was starting to pound as I looked at her. It was as
if she was confessing her love toward me......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あの……兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "Um...... niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Um...... niisan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「その……なんだ……萌先輩、とにかく立ちま
　しょう」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... well...... Moe-sempai, you can stand up now."
dialogues.text: "Umm...... well...... Moe-sempai, you can stand up now."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の周りにオーラを見た俺は、萌先輩にお立
ち頂く。いま、音夢の攻撃を受けたら、間違い
なく冥途行きだ。
dialogues.en:
I let Moe-sempai stand up as I felt a negative vibe coming
from Nemu. I'll die for sure if I get attacked by Nemu right
now.
dialogues.text:
I let Moe-sempai stand up as I felt a negative vibe coming
from Nemu. I'll die for sure if I get attacked by Nemu right
now.

dialogues.jp: 「それで、萌先輩。怪我は大丈夫なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "So Moe-sempai, how are your injuries?"
dialogues.text: "So Moe-sempai, how are your injuries?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。検査でも健康でした」
dialogues.en:
"I'm fine. They did a lot of medical tests, but I'm really
healthy."
dialogues.text:
"I'm fine. They did a lot of medical tests, but I'm really
healthy."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですか」
dialogues.en: "......That's good."
dialogues.text: "......That's good."

dialogues.jp:
健康という言葉の使い方はともかく、いつも通
りの先輩に安心する。
dialogues.en:
It's strange how she used the word 'healthy', but I felt
relieved to see her usual self.
dialogues.text:
It's strange how she used the word 'healthy', but I felt
relieved to see her usual self.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「これも、朝倉くんのおかげです。このご恩は、
　一生をかけて返しますね」
dialogues.en:
"It's all because of you, Asakura-kun. I'll pay you back
with all my life."
dialogues.text:
"It's all because of you, Asakura-kun. I'll pay you back
with all my life."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: それは一体どういう事で？
dialogues.en: What's that supposed to mean?
dialogues.text: What's that supposed to mean?

dialogues.jp:
本部のパワーレーダーが爆発した音が聞こえた
……ような気がする。
dialogues.en:
I think I heard the power raider exploding on the mother
ship......
dialogues.text:
I think I heard the power raider exploding on the mother
ship......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「明日からお見舞いに来ますね」
dialogues.en: "I'll come see you every day, from tomorrow on."
dialogues.text: "I'll come see you every day, from tomorrow on."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私は、今日｛・・・・／お見舞い｝しますね」
dialogues.en: "And I'll give something special to you later......"
dialogues.text: "And I'll give something special to you later......"

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩の笑顔を見つめながら、
これが見納めかもしれないと思うのだった。
dialogues.en:
As I stared at Moe-sempai's smile, I thought this may be the
last time I see her......
dialogues.text:
As I stared at Moe-sempai's smile, I thought this may be the
last time I see her......

dialogues.jp: ◆病院にて◆
dialogues.en: ◆At the hospital◆
dialogues.text: ◆At the hospital◆

dialogues.jp: 目が覚めると、目の前に音夢が居た。
dialogues.en: When I woke up, Nemu was in front of me.
dialogues.text: When I woke up, Nemu was in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
初めは状況は把握出来なかったが、どうやら俺
は、病院に居るらしかった。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't understand what was going on in the beginning,
but I guess I'm in the hospital.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't understand what was going on in the beginning,
but I guess I'm in the hospital.

dialogues.jp:
と、萌先輩がお見舞いにやって来てくれた。彼
女は、一生を掛けて、俺に対するご恩を返すと
おっしゃったのだ……。
dialogues.en:
Soon after I woke up, Moe-sempai came to visit me. She said
she'll pay me back with all of her life......
dialogues.text:
Soon after I woke up, Moe-sempai came to visit me. She said
she'll pay me back with all of her life......
